subject: Air freight quote: HAM to MEX
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from HAM to MEX (Mexico City, MX)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-28, and we’ll deliver it to Hamburg airport (HAM) ourselves.

It’s 3 pieces of cleaning agent (general cargo, non-dangerous), 583 kg gross and 4.32 cbm. The packing list is attached.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price for a new air-freight shipment.
